description: This is a sole source justification pertaining to solicitation 36C24126Q0306 for construction project 650-26-107. This solicitation is being presented to Multiple Award Task Order (MATOC) holders. A component of this solicitation requires a brand name piece of material to be compatible with the existing material, resulting in a sole source needed. In the spirit of transparancy, the VA is posting the sole source justification for the public to review. Please reference the sole source justification attached to this notice.
